messages.subject: Remove redundant and markers closer than 0.5 cM
parts:
Hello;

I'm new using rqtl, I have my complete map but in order to run the analysis I need to remove all the redundant and closer than 0.5cM, can anyone help me to do that. I tried using the whole map but then i got the next error: Some markers at the same position on chr 1A,1B,1D,2A,2B,2D,3A,3B,3D,4A,4B,4D,5A,5B,5D,6A,6B,6D,7A,7B,7D,Group 22,Group 23,Group 24,Group 25,Group 27,Group 29,Group 31; use jittermap().
2: In summary.cross(cross) : Duplicate markers [BS00103682_51]

In advance, thank you!
Cheers:)

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Remove redundant and markers closer than 0.5 cM
parts:
Use jittermap() to move the markers slightly away from each other.

  mycross <- jittermap(mycross)

But also note that it says you have two markers named BS00103682_51, so
you might want to remove one of those in advance.

Also look at the function findDupMarkers() to identify markers with
essentially the same genotypes, which you could then remove with
drop.markers().

  dup_mar <- findDupMarkers(mycross)
  mycross_reduced <- drop.markers(mycross, unlist(dup_mar))

There's also pickMarkerSubset() but it works only with a map and with
one chromosome at a time.

  data(hyper)
  map <- pull.map(hyper)
  for(i in seq_along(map)) {
    mar2keep <- pickMarkerSubset(map[[i]], 0.5)
    mar2drop <- names(map[[i]])[!(names(map[[i]]) %in% mar2keep)]
    hyper <- drop.markers(hyper, mar2drop)
  }

karl
